module: Fetches the 'sources' that the Terraform tool can follow: MeshRoad roads of the scene, RAT (Road Architect) roads, mesh splines, assembly splines and Master Splines. Each source is a list of points {pos = vec3, width = width, binormal = lateral unit vec3}. When a road enters and leaves the polygon, it is cut and only the inner parts are returned as separate sources. Splines are smoothed with Catmull-Rom (centripetal for mesh/assembly splines) with 10 points per segment. Consumed by editor_terraformTool and editor/terraform/terraform.
notes: Mesh and assembly splines get a fixed width of 3.0 m (defaultWidthForMeshSplines); MeshRoads use their real widths.
getAllSourcesInSelection only handles objects of class MeshRoad in editor.selection.object; RAT roads and splines are not handled in selection.
Only the parts that have at least 2 points in the polygon are kept (eIdx > sIdx).
MeshRoads are first filtered by XY (world) bounding box against that of the polygon.

getAllSourcesInPolygon.desc: Returns all supported sources in the polygon (MeshRoad, RAT roads, mesh splines, assembly splines, Master Splines). A road that crosses the edge is cut; only its inner parts are kept, as separate sources.

polygon.desc: List of 2D/3D polygon points (inferred from code: passed to geom.getAABB and geom.getNodeSpansInsidePolygon).

returns.desc: List of sources; each source is a list of {pos, width, binormal}.

getAllSourcesInSelection.desc: Returns the sources built from the MeshRoad objects currently selected in the editor (editor.selection.object).

returns.desc: List of sources (one per selected MeshRoad).
